parameters.jsCode: const base=$('12주 자료 정리').item.json; const content=String($json.message?.content||$json.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.map(p=>p.text||'').join('')||'').trim(); const usable=content.length>=80; const decision=usable&&content.startsWith('[결정필요]'); return [{json:{...base,summary:usable?content.slice(0,1800):'자동 분석 결과가 너무 짧아 기존 승인 계획을 유지합니다.',top_candidate:decision?'새 우선순위 검토 필요':'가습기 Tool → 온열가전 → Black Friday 가전',rationale:decision?content.slice(0,900):'제작·승인·검색 색인기간을 역산한 기존 계획 유지',decision_required:decision,decision_reason:decision?content.slice(0,700):''}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO commerce_trend_reports(report_date,horizon_start,horizon_end,sources,summary,top_candidate,rationale,decision_required) VALUES($1::date,$2::date,$3::date,$4::jsonb,$5,$6,$7,$8::boolean) ON CONFLICT(report_date) DO UPDATE SET horizon_start=EXCLUDED.horizon_start,horizon_end=EXCLUDED.horizon_end,sources=EXCLUDED.sources,summary=EXCLUDED.summary,top_candidate=EXCLUDED.top_candidate,rationale=EXCLUDED.rationale,decision_required=EXCLUDED.decision_required,created_at=NOW() RETURNING id,report_date,horizon_end,summary,top_candidate,rationale,decision_required;
